simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to נָשַׂק (H5400) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.

simple.summary: נָשַׂק (nâsaq) means to catch fire First listed occurrence: Ezek 39 9.

definitions.full: H5400. nasaq [ שָׂלִק ] verb kindle, burn (Ecclus 43:4 margin הִסִּיק , Neh 7:21 ; 7:23 הִשִּׂיק , burn ; Aramaic (also BA) סְלַק ascend , Aph`el cause to go up (in flame), offer sacrifice; , Palmyrene סלק ascend ); — Niph`al Perfect 3feminine singular בְיַעֲקֹב נִשְּׂקָה אֵשׁ Psa 78:21 a fire was kindled against Jacob. Hiph`il make a fire burn: Perfect 3plural consecutive וְהִשִּׂיקוּ , with ב of thing; Imperfect 3masculine singular absolute יְשִּׂיק Isa 44:15 (both || בִּעֵר ).
